# ChatPlex compatibility providers

Native-boundary sources derive from the MIT-licensed ChatPlexSDK-BS checkout at signed commit 73d16a6, based on the maintained 1.46.0 implementation. Shared providers preserve SDK namespaces and APIs while selecting real target-native signatures. The consumer retains unrelated implementation files; the selected original source files are excluded only when the provider flag is enabled. Source includes current request ownership, submission and asynchronous menu initialization behavior. Fresh native 1.29.1 and isolated 1.46.0 builds have zero warnings/errors. Compiled metadata matches four native patch targets and three completion callbacks per target. Runtime behavior remains unconfirmed.

The expanded providers also retain native boundary files from the same SDK source and CP_SDK submodule commit 72404db19f1dca1bef365fd331f5d31da829e4bc. Original source files remain in their repositories and are excluded from this consumer build. The ZIP AES derivation remains PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1 with its original key-round count; the three-argument native framework constructor provides that same derivation. No archive data is rewritten.
